fonts.display: 'Helvetica', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'minion-3', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Body text, headings, nav links, hairline borders, and link underlines — the single type color across the entire system

palette.name: Canvas White
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, reverse text on dark photographic regions

palette.name: Warm Linen
palette.role: Soft section background, the first step off pure white — gives a page the warmth of unbleached paper

palette.name: Pale Sage
palette.role: Tinted section panels, the dominant non-white canvas tone

palette.name: Driftwood
palette.role: Deeper warm section background, used when a panel needs to recede from Pale Sage

palette.name: Olive Stone
palette.role: Saturated warm section background — the deepest neutral step before any chromatic color enters

palette.name: Weathered Taupe
palette.role: Muted section background, used sparingly as a quieter alternative to Olive Stone

palette.name: Soft Pebble
palette.role: Light warm-gray section background, the coolest of the earth-tone neutrals

palette.name: Garden Green
palette.role: Footer background only — the single chromatic accent in the system, used as a deliberate closing beat rather than a brand color spread across the UI
